items.stem: Which goodness-of-fit consideration favours a more complex severity model only if justified?

options.text: Penalizing extra parameters, e.g. with AIC or BIC
options.rationale: Correct: information criteria penalize complexity to avoid overfitting.

options.text: Always choosing the model with the most parameters
options.rationale: More parameters can overfit; complexity must be justified.
The log-likelihood is central to model comparison.

options.text: Selecting the model with the largest number of data points
options.rationale: Data size is not a model-selection criterion by itself.
